items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: after awhile, Big Sid came in on drums in place of Yank Porter, and after Sid, I think Sid might have gone with the Armstrong All Stars or something there, and then J.C. came back with me, J.C. was in my small band.

ctx.x: Yes, oh yes. She was. Irene had a little band over on Cottage Grove, I forget the name of that little club, and Big Sid was her drummer at one *The Cottage Cafe
time, and she had an excellent saxophone player, I can't remember his name, and Earl Hines' old girlfriend, Katherine Perry --
